content: Snap tools: Rectangle (~30k stars) keyboard shortcuts + drag-to-snap, URL scheme rectangle://execute-action?name=; top issues: slow with Chrome, snapping randomly stops, breaks on macOS releases. Rectangle Pro adds layouts, stash, URL execute-layout. Loop (GPL-3, ~11.9k) radial menu trigger key + cursor direction with preview, theming, stash, cycles; issues: WindowServer leak, slowdowns. macOS 15+ native tiling: drag to edges/corners, Option-drag, green-button menu, fn-ctrl-arrow shortcuts, preview; ~8px fixed gaps; apps with min sizes overlap.
